title: QR Code Payment Scam
description: A stranger claimed they needed to send me money and asked me to scan a QR code. After scanning it, ₹9,500 was deducted from my bank account instead of being credited.

title: Fake Electricity Bill Scam
description: I received an SMS stating that my electricity connection would be disconnected unless I paid an overdue bill immediately. The message contained a fraudulent payment link. After making the payment, I discovered the electricity department had not sent the message.

title: Fraudulent Charity Donation Request
description: I received a social media message requesting donations for flood relief. The campaign appeared genuine, but after donating ₹15,000 I learned the charity organization did not exist.

title: Job Offer Registration Scam
description: A company offered me a work-from-home position but requested a registration fee of ₹4,500 before issuing the appointment letter. After payment, all contact details became inactive.

title: Fake Customer Care Refund Scam
description: I searched online for customer care of an e-commerce website and called the first number that appeared. The representative convinced me to install a remote access application to process a refund. Money was transferred from my account without authorization.

title: Matrimonial Profile Fraud
description: I met someone through a matrimonial website who claimed to be working abroad. After several conversations they requested financial assistance for an emergency. I transferred ₹55,000 before realizing the profile was fake.

title: ATM Skimming Incident at Commercial Street
description: The bank received an alert regarding a customer's debit card cloned using a physical skimmer at an off-site ATM kiosk on Commercial Street. An unauthorized cash withdrawal of ₹10,000 was executed without the cardholder's authorization.

title: Manipulated Airport Taxi Fare Application
description: After hailing a private cab from the international airport, the driver utilized a tampered third-party navigation meter app that charged ₹4,500 instead of standard regulated rates and refused to let me exit until payment was made.

title: Fake Rooftop Solar Subsidy Scam
description: A salesperson claiming to represent GreenSolar Solutions visited my residence promising a 60 percent state solar subsidy. I paid ₹18,000 as a site feasibility survey deposit. The individual disappeared and the company was non-existent.

title: Bogus Overseas Medical Conference Registration
description: I received an invitation to present at a purported international cardiology summit organized by GlobalHealth Summits. I remitted ₹38,000 for delegate registration before discovering the conference venue had no booking under that name.

title: Unauthorized NFC Transit Reader Tap
description: A passenger registered a police station complaint after noticing an unauthorized deduction of ₹1,900 from their contactless debit card while commuting on a packed metro train, suspected to be executed via a concealed portable POS terminal.

title: Phony Pet Adoption Logistics Advance
description: I attempted to adopt a rescue golden retriever puppy advertised on social media. The supposed foster home instructed me to pay ₹6,500 for a climate-controlled pet carrier and transit clearance. After sending the payment, the foster profile was deleted.

title: Fraudulent Domestic Helper Agency Registration Fee
description: I contacted an agency calling itself City Domestic Care to hire a full-time elder care assistant. They demanded a registration and police verification fee of ₹7,000. Once paid, the agency disconnected all contact numbers.

title: Rental Apartment Token Deposit Fraud
description: Cyber crime division received a complaint from a prospective tenant who paid ₹25,000 as an advance security token to a fake property owner on a rental listing site. The key handover was scheduled, but the apartment was actually occupied by genuine owners.

title: Spurious Two-Wheeler Insurance Policy Fraud
description: I purchased third-party motorcycle insurance through an unverified discount link for ₹3,200. When I requested verification from the national insurance repository, the policy certificate was identified as completely counterfeit.

title: Online Astrological Remedial Gemstone Scam
description: A spiritual consultation website charged ₹14,000 for custom energized gemstones promised to resolve personal disputes. The package never arrived and the customer support helpline was terminated.

title: Fake Agricultural Equipment Subsidy Fee
description: A rural police outpost forwarded a complaint by a farmer who was persuaded to pay ₹5,500 as an application fee for a subsidized tractor scheme by an imposter claiming to be a district agriculture extension officer.

title: Bank Account Compromise via Public Charging Kiosk
description: A customer reported unauthorized funds transfer of ₹12,000 occurring shortly after connecting a mobile phone to a public USB charging station at a transit terminal, indicating potential juice-jacking malware payload.
